objective: Find the owner of the Ancient Petrified Leaf. Good luck, <name>; It's a big world.

description: The epidermis of the leaf glows a bright green. The surface is extremely rugose, exposing several veins and wrinkles.
If you had to take a guess, you would say this leaf came from something ancient and powerful.
Maybe you should find the original owner of this leaf?
completion: Of course I recognize my own leaves. Look at that! It's in perfect condition.
How good of you to return it, <class>.
Perhaps you could be of service to us and we to you.
